criteria.evidence: quickQuestionFor picks the first MUST_HAVE EXPERIENCE/SOFT_SKILL with normalised GAP/PARTIAL and returns {requirementId, text, why, options[3]}. Test 'natural yes/no wording with other word forms is kept' covers the Northwind JD + default (Saffron Retail) profile + 'Presenting to senior stakeholders' -> 'Have you presented to senior stakeholders?' kept as req-1, and the prototype copy 'Have you presented to senior leaders?' kept against 'present findings to senior leaders'. Scratch copy of the filter: the prototype question is kept; the prototype's generic why ('It's a must-have for this role, and your resume doesn't mention it.') is nulled because the why must use requirement/JD words (D25 by design; the prompt asks for a JD-worded why).
find() -> undefined -> null; test 'question is null when every must-have is MET or the only gaps are skill, tool or education' covers both branches.

Array.find in req-1..n order, at most one question, no fallback; test 'only the first qualifying requirement is asked and an invalid first wording never falls back'. Prompt now asks for wording only on the first MUST_HAVE EXPERIENCE/SOFT_SKILL the model sets to GAP or PARTIAL; a server MET->GAP normalisation gives null (fails closed).

Trim + 80/200 caps (schema .trim().max().catch(null) and re-checked in quickQuestionFor), final '?', first token in {have,has,do,does,did,are,is,were,can,could}, no '.', '!', '?' or ';' before the end (digits after excepted), at least one content word in text and why, bannedWords, and wordedFrom against requirement + jobText with s/es/ed/d/ing/er stripping (stems >= 3 chars). Scratch run of the exact code: 'Have you?'/'As shown.' null; 'Who builds ...?' null; leading statement with '.' null; 81 chars null; I.3 words (fit, ATS, ideal candidate, guarantee) null; employer not in JD (Infosys) null in text or why; employer the JD names (Northwind) kept, returned only in the response (no insert or log in analyses.ts); numbers/decimals/years not in the source null; 'managers' vs 'manage' do not collide, 'tester'/'test' collide only within one word family; 2-char stems never form. Residual, model-misbehaviour only and still JD-worded: a clause before the question joined by ':', a newline, an ellipsis or a dash passes, as does 'Do you use SQL or Python?' (choice). Not reported: no candidate fact can enter.
Selection reads match.status after evidence-id and stated-skill normalisation; test 'a normalised gap or partial status selects the requirement for the question'.

docs/architecture.md /analyses bullet describes the rule, null cases, stemming and that question/why are not stored or logged (no insert or log of them in analyses.ts). Local: typecheck, lint, format:check, boundaries pass; node --test test/tailormyresume-analyses.test.ts against a throwaway local Postgres 47/48, CI Validation 558/559; the only failure in both is the golden 'without userStatedSkills the analysis prompt equals the one on main' (lead-only fixture). Secret scan and pregate pass. Head merges cleanly onto base 27b1cc1. Rebase delta: reasonFor and citedFactTexts are byte-identical to a7f501f (D23 semantics kept); the only removed src line is the .map signature; only quickQuestionFor uses wordedFrom/stems. Scale: one extra prompt sentence; output worst case about 5,700 tokens vs the 8,000 cap now that wording is asked once.

findings.rule: Checklist 5 / round-1 low 3 disposition ('Candidate facts never feed it' must be proven): the test must fail if cited candidate facts enter the question allowlist
findings.trigger: Mutation in a scratch copy: append citedFactTexts(profile, keptIds, stated) to the question source in quickQuestionFor. All question tests stay green (47/48, only the golden fails). The employer test cites only bullet EXP-09-1 ('Built weekly reports.'), whose cited text has no 'Infosys', and the new 'q-isolate' test uses a GAP with no evidence and the Saffron Retail profile, so no test has the employer inside a cited fact. Feeding the whole profile (factTexts) is caught by the employer test, but feeding cited facts, the pattern reasonFor uses next door, is not.
findings.title: No test catches cited candidate facts leaking into the question allowlist
findings.proof: In 'a question naming the employer of a partial soft-skill gap ...', cite the entry as well: evidenceIds ['EXP-09', 'EXP-09-1'] (fact text 'Analyst, Infosys'), keep status PARTIAL and expect question null. Under the mutation above it then fails; at head it passes.
